items.lede: Today, gig economy drivers are classified as contractors. This settlement clears up a lingering lawsuit from 2020 when that was still an unanswered issue.
items.title: Lyft is paying $272.5M to settle lawsuit over how it classified drivers

items.lede: Critics say workers are still owed far more.
items.title: Lyft settles landmark driver misclassification lawsuit for $272.5M
